pages.title: Piece of Cake: Merge and Bake
pages.creator: HG POINT
pages.description:
Piece of Cake: Merge and Bake combines item-merging puzzles with restoring and running a cafe. Drag identical pieces together on the board to create the dishes and objects requested by customers. Completing those orders earns money that can be spent on renovating the cafe and other locations.

The business develops alongside a story involving relationships, family, and hidden secrets. Keep track of the combinations needed for current orders while working toward the next restoration. The merge board supplies what customers want, and their payments move the broader cafe project forward.

pages.title: Toss The Ring
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Toss The Ring focuses on aimed ring throws across a sequence of stages. Click and drag to set up a throw, then release toward the target. Adjust your next attempt as you work through the changing level arrangements.

pages.title: Number Bubble Shooter Wild West
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Number Bubble Shooter Wild West combines bubble shooting with number merging. Aim toward bubbles carrying the same value and join at least two to create a higher number. Set up successive merges to build combos and keep room available on the board.

pages.title: Dino Idle Park
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Dino Idle Park puts you in charge of a dinosaur amusement park. Open plots, display dinosaurs and manage visitor queues while hiring staff and improving facilities. Reinvest the income to expand the park, balancing its growth with safety and visitor satisfaction.

pages.title: Sort Water Now
pages.creator: HeiTie
pages.description: Sort Water Now asks you to separate mixed liquids until each bottle contains a single color. Select a bottle to lift it, then choose another for the pour. Plan the transfers around the available space so the remaining colors can still be sorted.

pages.title: Tung Sahur Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Tung Sahur Coloring gives you character drawings to fill with virtual crayons. Choose colors and apply them to the picture, trying different combinations across the outlined areas. The activity lets you create your own colored version of the selected scene.

pages.title: King of Crabs
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: King of Crabs sends your crab into fights with other crabs. Find a shell for protection, eat fish to grow and attack opponents you can overcome. Compare armor and abilities in the gallery, then improve the crab's equipment for later battles.

pages.title: Hole Eat Grow Attack
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Hole Eat Grow Attack places competing holes in an arena full of objects and ammunition to swallow. Gather material, grow and attack the other holes. Choose Time Attack or Infinite mode, playing alone or sharing the controls with a second player.

pages.title: Huggy Wuggy Guess the right door
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Huggy Wuggy Guess the right door sends you through a factory with three doors in each room. Choose a route while avoiding the door hiding Huggy Wuggy. Make it through fifty rooms to find the exit from the haunted building.

pages.title: Ball Paint 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Ball Paint 3D asks you to recolor a three-dimensional arrangement using a limited supply of paint balls. Choose where to throw each color and watch how the model changes, working toward a single matching color before the available throws run out.

pages.title: Ragdoll Mega Dunk
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Ragdoll Mega Dunk turns a basketball dunk into a full-body stunt. Guide a run and jump that launches the ragdoll character toward the basket along with the ball. Adjust the attempt's trajectory to send the character into the hoop.

pages.title: Fish Story 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Fish Story 2 follows a mermaid through underwater matching puzzles. Match at least three identical sea-themed items to work toward each stage's stars. Larger matching groups create boosters that help clear the board as you progress along the level map.

pages.title: Kings Clash
pages.creator: Lipsar Studio LLC
pages.description: Kings Clash asks you to build an army by merging identical units into stronger fighters. Send the force into battles to capture castles, choosing equipment and adding reinforcements when needed. Each successful upgrade helps extend your army's influence across the map.

pages.title: Arrow Fest
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Arrow Fest puts you in control of a moving group of arrows. Steer through gates that increase the volley and use the larger force against enemies and giants. Collect coins to improve the arrows and the income earned on later runs.

pages.title: Circuit Car Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Circuit Car Racing challenges you to finish first in each race. Steer around the circuit and control your speed through the bends, using the brakes to keep the car positioned as you work toward overtaking the competition.

pages.title: Dynasty War
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Dynasty War sets four rulers against each other during the Three Kingdoms conflict. Choose a campaign and direct your army through battles for the map, combining officers, warrior types, buildings and magic. Upgrade the force as the opposing armies become harder to defeat.

pages.title: BFF Long Frocks Style
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: BFF Long Frocks Style lets you dress Clara, Mia and Ava for a weekend party. Choose long dresses and coordinate the accompanying accessories, creating a separate finished look for each princess within the group's chosen fashion theme.

pages.title: Fastening Challenge
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fastening Challenge sends matching objects along opposite lanes. Tap when identical items face one another to fasten them together and meet the level's quota. Wrong pairings cost lives, while the limited timer rewards spotting useful matches quickly.

pages.title: The Online Influencers
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: The Online Influencers follows social-media personalities preparing for prom and homecoming. Work through their makeup routines and choose clothing for the occasions, combining the available styling choices into a finished event look for each character.

pages.title: Marie Become a Mommy
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Marie Become a Mommy helps Marie prepare for a trip to the hospital. Find the items on her checklist, then explore her maternity wardrobe and choose makeup. Complete the preparations while putting together an outfit she wants to wear.

pages.title: Castle Defense
pages.creator: Emoji Games GmbH
pages.description: Castle Defense asks you to protect a castle by building defenders beside the enemy's route. Earn E-points during the defense and use them to develop the position. Combine different defender types with magical skills to stop the attacking monsters.

pages.title: Vector Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Vector Rush follows a runner escaping an earthquake across collapsing rooftops. Time jumps between buildings and slides under debris to stay ahead of the destruction, collecting coins as you work toward the end of each stage.

pages.title: GTR Drift Fever
pages.creator: afewanima
pages.description: GTR Drift Fever gives you sports cars and several locations for drift-driving challenges. Take a car onto a drift track or city route and work toward a better score, controlling the slides as you complete the level's driving task.

pages.title: Cartoon Coloring for Kids Animals
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Cartoon Coloring for Kids Animals offers twelve animal drawings for coloring. Choose an outline and apply your preferred shades to its different areas, experimenting with combinations until the animal picture has the finished appearance you want.

pages.title: Among Them: Craft Mod
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Among Them: Craft Mod gives you a block-built world to shape through construction. Select blocks and place them to create your own surroundings, developing the landscape and structures as you explore the game's building options.

pages.title: Funny Bone Surgery
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Bone Surgery follows Leah after a skateboarding accident leaves her arm and foot injured. Help with the game's virtual medical activities to address the injuries and broken bones, working through the care needed for her recovery.

pages.title: Witch Alchemist Saga
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Witch Alchemist Saga takes match-three puzzles into a magical setting. Arrange matching pieces to work through the boards and unlock further stages, considering the available combinations as you tackle the next puzzle in the witch's journey.

pages.title: Panzer Hero
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Panzer Hero lets you choose from four tank classes for an arena battle against other tanks. Navigate around enemy fire and time your shots to eliminate opponents. Successful fighting moves your tank upward on the game's leaderboard.

pages.title: Crazy Jelly Match
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Crazy Jelly Match puts colorful jelly pieces on a match-three board. Find matching combinations and arrange the pieces to remove them, looking for the next useful move as you try to improve the score during the round.

pages.title: Stickman Fighting 2 Player
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Stickman Fighting 2 Player pits ragdoll-style stick fighters against one another. Control a warrior through the close combat and try to defeat the opposing fighter, reacting to the characters' movement as the two-player battle develops.

pages.title: Real Excavtor City Construction Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Real Excavtor City Construction Game puts you to work on a city construction site. Operate heavy vehicles through road-building tasks, using equipment such as excavators and dump trucks to carry out the work assigned by the game.

pages.title: 3D Chess
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: 3D Chess offers matches against another player or a computer opponent with four difficulty settings. Choose a six-by-six or eight-by-eight board and plan your moves across the position. Shared mouse or touch controls let both players take their turns.

pages.title: Pancake Master
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pancake Master challenges you to flip pancakes from one frying pan into the next. Hold to control the strength of the toss and release when the landing looks right. Later stages make those pan-to-pan transfers harder to judge.

pages.title: Rotated dots
pages.creator: OcelotGames
pages.description: Rotated dots asks you to shoot a colored dot toward a matching central dot. Watch the current direction and fire within the short time allowance. Hitting a different color ends the attempt, while the firing direction changes unpredictably.

pages.title: Drift Car Racing
pages.creator: AvariGames
pages.description: Drift Car Racing gives you a sports car to customize and drive through open maps. Explore the area and practice sliding through turns, using nitro and the handbrake to adjust the car's movement as you try different routes.

pages.title: City Scooter Rides Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: City Scooter Rides Jigsaw includes twelve scooter-themed pictures to rebuild. Choose a layout of 25, 49 or 100 pieces, then fit the scattered sections together. The selected piece count changes how much of the scene each fragment reveals.

pages.title: Break color
pages.creator: Nicolas Tacgorian
pages.description: Break color challenges you to select the color that matches the next prompt before time runs out. Use the colored buttons or corresponding keys to score points for correct choices, keeping the sequence going to improve your personal best.

pages.title: Fruit Link Splash Match 3 Mania
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Fruit Link Splash Match 3 Mania turns fruit matching into a chain-drawing puzzle. Connect matching fruits in long lines to burst them together, searching the board for a useful route through the pieces before choosing your next chain.

pages.title: Jigsaw surprise
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Jigsaw surprise briefly shows you a complete picture before scattering it into pieces. Remember the scene and fit the fragments back together to restore it, choosing an easy, medium or difficult layout for the puzzle.

pages.title: Girls Fashion Show Dress Up
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Girls Fashion Show Dress Up lets you put together a model's outfit for a fashion-show appearance. Browse the clothing and coordinate a complete look, experimenting with combinations that suit a runway presentation or red-carpet event.

pages.title: Monster Truck Stunts Sky Driving
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Monster Truck Stunts Sky Driving sends one of three monster trucks onto elevated stunt tracks. Steer across the course and use the brakes to control its approach to obstacles, working through the driving challenges without losing the truck's balance.

pages.title: Fishing With Pa
pages.creator: Cat Summer
pages.description: Fishing With Pa lets you help Grandpa catch fish with his fishing rod. Cast the line and work toward bringing in a catch, building up the fishing session's rewards. Improve the pole to make later catches easier to manage.

pages.title: Railway Runner 3D
pages.creator: Super Apps
pages.description: Railway Runner 3D sends a runner along sections with three, four or five tracks. Adjust the character's position as the route changes and use the hovercraft control when needed. The game offers endless running alongside a multiplayer mode.

pages.title: Mini Guardians: Castle Defense
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Mini Guardians: Castle Defense places your guardians between a princess's towers and attackers arriving from both sides. Aim at the approaching creatures and interact with the defenses, responding to threats that include dragons and giant spiders to protect the bastion.

pages.title: Car Eats Car: Winter Adventure
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Car Eats Car: Winter Adventure combines hilly driving with battles against pursuing cars. Use turbo to gain ground, drop bombs and balance the vehicle over the terrain. Develop cars through the incubator while trying to rescue imprisoned friends.

pages.title: Christmas Ride
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Christmas Ride follows Santa in a flying sleigh collecting presents around the North Pole. Touch the screen to raise the sleigh and steer its flight around balloons, aiming to carry more gifts through the game's six levels.

pages.title: Hospital Doctor Emergency Room
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Hospital Doctor Emergency Room puts you in a virtual clinic treating patients with hand injuries. Select and position care items to address cuts, close wounds and apply dressings, completing each patient's activities before moving to the next case.

pages.title: Spooky Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Spooky Bubble Shooter hides golden jack-o'-lanterns among colored zombie eyes. Shoot matching eyes into groups of at least three to clear a path to the lanterns. Collect every lantern to complete each of the seventy-two levels.

pages.title: Sweety Mahjong
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Sweety Mahjong fills its tile layouts with candy symbols. Find two matching tiles and select them to remove the pair, looking across the remaining arrangement for the next available match as you work toward clearing the board.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Gold Mining
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Gold Mining asks you to uncover gold buried among bubbles. Aim and shoot toward matching groups to clear the surrounding field, using special bubbles and power-ups where helpful. Collect every gold piece to finish each level.

pages.title: Ludo with Friends
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Ludo with Friends lets you race tokens toward the center of a Ludo board. Roll the die and choose which piece to move, comparing its progress with the other players as you try to bring your tokens home first.

pages.title: Shoot The Words
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Shoot The Words gives you words to hit before a timer expires. Aim with the mouse and fire at the remaining targets, working through the displayed words quickly enough to clear them all within the round's time allowance.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Pet Match
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Pet Match puts a squirrel beneath a field of colored bubbles. Aim and shoot to connect matching bubbles and remove clusters, dropping pieces that lose their support. Swap the loaded bubble when the waiting color offers a better shot.

pages.title: Princesses Chic Trends
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princesses Chic Trends helps Emma, Bonnie and Belle create fashionable new looks. Choose chic outfits for the three girls and coordinate their room decoration with the same theme, combining clothing and interior choices into the finished presentation.

pages.title: Emilys Folklore Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Emilys Folklore Fashion follows Emily preparing a folklore-inspired look for a party. Start with matching makeup, then select clothing and accessories that carry the theme through her outfit. Coordinate the pieces before finishing her party preparation.

pages.title: Cute Puppies Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Cute Puppies Jigsaw includes six puppy pictures with four puzzle sizes each. Choose 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces and rebuild your selected image, fitting the fragments together while trying to improve the time taken to finish.

pages.title: Chicken Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Chicken Coloring Book provides chicken drawings to fill with your choice of colors. Select an image and brush shade, then apply the color to its outlined areas. Experiment with different combinations to create a finished version of the picture.

pages.title: Kung Fu Street
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Kung Fu Street pits a fighter against enemies approaching from the left and right. Choose an attack direction and time punches to stop opponents before they strike. Keep reacting to the next attacker as the street-fighting encounter continues.

pages.title: Couple Hawaii Vacation
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Couple Hawaii Vacation lets you style couples for a Hawaiian holiday. Choose new clothes and accessories for each person, coordinating their vacation looks. Finish by selecting a background that suits the outfits and their trip together.

pages.title: Soccer Stars Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Soccer Stars Jigsaw offers football-themed pictures to assemble at three difficulty settings. Finish puzzles to earn in-game currency, with harder modes giving larger rewards. Use the earnings to unlock more pictures and continue fitting their scattered pieces into place.

pages.title: Words Challenge
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Words Challenge asks you to form words by selecting letters in the correct order. Click individual letters or swipe across them to create an answer, using hints and power-ups when a word is difficult to identify.

pages.title: Fast Driver
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Fast Driver challenges you to keep a car moving quickly through road traffic. Tap or steer left and right to find a clear route, avoiding other vehicles and roadside obstacles so the drive can continue.

pages.title: Désiré Chapter I
pages.creator: Sylvain Seccia
pages.description: Désiré Chapter I follows a color-blind protagonist through a black-and-white point-and-click adventure. Explore his world and interact with the characters he meets, uncovering the encounters that influence his emotions and change the way he views life.

pages.title: Space Ripper Plastiline
pages.creator: Rumata Lab
pages.description: Space Ripper Plastiline puts you in a demanding space-shooting battle with little health to spare. Fire at the dangerous enemies and keep your ship alive through their attacks. The challenge centers on surviving a sustained five-minute encounter.

pages.title: Pixel Cat Can t Fly
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Pixel Cat Can t Fly asks you to keep a pixel cat airborne through gaps in walls. Tap to make the cat jump and adjust its height for each opening. Touching a surface ends the flight, so every correction affects the next passage.

pages.title: Pony Dress Up
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Pony Dress Up combines caring for a pony with changing its appearance. Clean and brush the animal to prepare it, then explore the customization choices. Put together the look you prefer while completing the pony's grooming routine.

pages.title: Tap Tap Lycaon Too Difficult
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tap Tap Lycaon Too Difficult follows a bouncing animal inside a dangerous temple. Tap to jump and keep it moving between the walls while avoiding spikes. Watch the next landing carefully as the spike arrangements threaten the route.

pages.title: Baby Snow Sick Day
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Baby Snow Sick Day follows a sick Snow White through virtual care activities. Prepare food and complete the game's remedy-making tasks to help her character recover, selecting the items needed as you work through the day.

pages.title: Flipping Gun Simulator
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Flipping Gun Simulator uses shooting to send a rotating weapon through the air. Time each tap while the gun turns, collecting coins and keeping the attempt going. Different weapons provide further ways to try the physics-based firing challenge.

pages.title: Pregnancy Shopping
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pregnancy Shopping takes two expectant princesses to the mall for new clothes. Browse the clothing and accessories, then coordinate an outfit for each woman. Try different combinations to create two finished looks for their shopping trip.

pages.title: Ice Skater Princess Dressup
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description: Ice Skater Princess Dressup lets you prepare a skater for an annual ice-skating competition. Choose a dress and coordinate the available fashion pieces around it, putting together the finished appearance she will wear on the rink.

pages.title: Snake VS Blocks
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Snake VS Blocks challenges you to steer a snake through numbered barriers. Choose blocks with lower health so the snake can survive the crossing, comparing the routes ahead before committing to the next part of the field.

pages.title: My Dolphin Show 8
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: My Dolphin Show 8 puts you in control of a dolphin performing for an audience. Jump through hoops, splash spectators and complete tricks such as scoring a football goal. Mini-games and a sequence of aquatic show levels continue the performance.

pages.title: Meet Puppy
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Meet Puppy asks you to bring two separated puppies together. Remove boxes from the scene to open a route between them, considering what will move when a support disappears. Work through the arrangements to reunite the pair.

pages.title: Hipster Girl
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Hipster Girl gives you a wardrobe for creating a hipster-inspired outfit. Choose clothing and coordinate the character's style, comparing different combinations to decide how the finished look should express the fashion theme.
